title: Valmor Protocol
tagline: Building infra for the next-gen of defi automation agents
description:
### Defi Liquidity is Fragmented
With different protocols for different purposes, its hard for users to keep track of their positions, having the same contract instance deployed across multiple chains, there's no one platform that allows users to manage their bridges, swaps, yield etc in one place.

### High Entry Barrier
- Users need to familiarize themselves with different protocols
- Acquire various diff tokens to get started on the platform
- Transactions may/not be secure

With Valmor Protocol, users get access to all defi protocols across different chains, on a single platform.
